The '''Xoman system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xoman III]].
